sources.description: A new week is underway, as the Atlanta Falcons and Baltimore Ravens prepare to face off on Sunday evening. The Falcons have now won back-to-back primetime games, and they look to make it a third. For that, they’re going to need some of their currently banged up players to get healthy. Let’s take a look!
